detail: Footnote 185, page 23: quote held a reported metric (40% of drafts on ENER) and, in the next sentence, the Commission's finding of a sharp decrease from 86% in 2018; -0008 cut to the first sentence, second sentence added as finding -0009.

Pages 1-30 keyword screened; no missed claims added.
